verses.text: "Listen to me, you who chase after righteousness, you who look for the LORD. Look to the rock you were cut from, and to the stone quarry you were dug out of.
Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who gave birth to you. When I called him, he was only one man. But I blessed him and made him many.

For the LORD will comfort Zion. He will comfort all her ruins. He will make her deserts like Eden, and her dry lands like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found there, thanksgiving and the sound of singing.
Listen to me, my people. Hear me, my nation. For my teaching will go out from me, and my justice will become a light to the nations.
My righteousness is coming near. My salvation is on its way, and my arm will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look to me and wait with hope for my arm.

Look up at the heavens, and look down at the earth below. The heavens will disappear like smoke, and the earth will wear out like old clothes. Its people will die like flies. But my salvation will last forever, and my righteousness will never fail.
Listen to me, you who know what is right, you people who have my teaching in your hearts. Do not be afraid of people's insults, and do not be frightened when they mock you.
For moths will eat them up like clothes, and worms will eat them like wool. But my righteousness will last forever, and my salvation from generation to generation."
Wake up, wake up, arm of the LORD, and clothe yourself with strength! Wake up as in the days of old, as in generations long ago. Was it not you who cut Rahab to pieces, who stabbed that sea monster?
Was it not you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, and made a road in the depths of the sea for the people you rescued to cross over?

Those the LORD has set free will come back. They will enter Zion singing, and everlasting joy will be on their heads like a crown. Gladness and joy will fill them, and sorrow and sighing will run away.
"I, yes I, am the one who comforts you. Why are you afraid of mere humans who die, of people who are only grass?

Why have you forgotten the LORD your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth? Why do you live in constant fear every day of the anger of the one who treats you cruelly, who is ready to destroy? Where is the anger of that cruel one now?
The prisoners bent low in chains will soon be set free. They will not die in their dungeon, and they will not go without food.
For I am the LORD your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. The LORD of Armies is my name.
I have put my words in your mouth and covered you with the shadow of my hand. I set the heavens in place and laid the foundations of the earth, and I say to Zion, 'You are my people.'"
Wake up, wake up! Stand up, Jerusalem! You have drunk from the LORD's hand the cup of his anger. You have drunk to the bottom of the bowl that makes people stagger.
Of all the sons she gave birth to, there is no one to guide her. Of all the sons she raised, there is no one to take her by the hand.
These two disasters have come on you. Who will comfort you? Ruin and destruction, hunger and the sword. Who will comfort you?
Your sons have fainted. They lie at the corner of every street, like an antelope caught in a net. They are filled with the anger of the LORD and the stern warning of your God.
So listen to this, you who are suffering, who are drunk, but not with wine.
This is what your Lord GOD says, your God who defends his people: "Look, I have taken out of your hand the cup that made you stagger. You will never again drink from the bowl of my anger.
I will put it into the hands of those who tormented you, who said to you, 'Lie down so we can walk on you.' You made your back like the ground, like a street for them to walk on."
